title: Legendary Single-Walled Canteen
content: I absolutely LOVE this canteen and not just because it’s excellent lid design but because it has been with me for years to the point where people knew me at work as “Thst Canteen Guy”  It holds alot of water but it’s also one of the VERY few designs that are single walled.  It’s nice to have double walled for keeping things at a constant hot or cold for short term hiking etc…but for serious life and death survival situations you ABSOLUTELY NEED a single walled design to boil water in so it’s safe to drink.  Obviously it’ll be extremely hot so you’ll have to let it cool first but you won’t have to carry additional weight for a pan to boil it in ad you can boil a significant portion of water all at once instead of using something big clunky or too small to fill it a little at a time.  I will also add I still own my old ones but the seals drip some from long time use yet still do the job.  Lastly I will attest to there supreme durability seeing as I’ve had both fall off the roof of my car and get ran over.  As I said before I still use both of them.  One more quick thing.  Shout out to Pathfinder for making what could almost be the best canteens if they took a chance at a better lid design and handles so you could carry one without a case.  This is why I carry my Stanley and no others.  They don’t require a case and the lid design is great.  I even used the smaller portable lid as a tea cup or a water bowl for my dog on long treks.  Bravo for making this amazing canteen!!!!!

title: Added Barriers with each Updated
content: I’ve been using this app for a couple of years and only for the use of tracking all my packages in one place. It’s convenient in that aspect. You’ll get an updated status on your packages in route to you within the app and also a quick link that will direct you to the shipping website to further confirm the status of your package. There are times, when the app won’t reflect the actual location or update of your package en route but you would have that direct link to show you where your package is at. What I’m noticing now with these updates is that ability to directly click on the link to the original shipping website. What used to be a simple task, is now barred with these extra steps/barriers to actually get to that direct link. With the current update, I now have to click on my package, then click on a small link associated with the tracking number and then click on the actual direct link to the shipping website. That’s three pages/clicks I have to perform just to make it to the direct shipping link. Before this update, it was just two clicks. And before that, just one click. Why make this difficult? What started off as a great experience I had with this app is slowly deteriorating with these updates. I’ll see how this goes for now, but I’ll be looking for another app in the meantime if I still have to jump through all these loops just to gain access to the direct link to the shipping website of my package.

title: ShopApp can literally read your emails, BEWARE.
content:
I loved the ShopApp for a long time, it’s like being able to window shop practically all of your favorite online retailers in one place, no opening a million tabs or making new Bookmark folders or new Favorites folders for whenever you happen upon a new site. I get mostly-accurate recommendations on shops I’ll probably like. If there was a “what budget would you like to stay in?” sliding scale type question, I think that would help a lot. Cus it pains me to see beautiful pieces from brands I’ve never heard of, & lo-and-behold, one piece can cost in the hundreds, a top & bottom easily going into the thousands. Would rather I just have never known about it…

But anyways I went into my Google security settings & I wish I could upload screenshots because Google explicitly states that by downloading the ShopApp, you give “them” permission to view your emailS & no I don’t mean your email to send you ads & reminders. I mean they literally can go into the email you provided to them & read anything that you can. They can delete your emails, write emails on your behalf, & Google won’t alert you to any of this because you granted ShopApp access so it doesn’t detect them as a threat or unusual activity.

Since I can’t post screenshots, if you want to see for yourself, go to your security settings in the gmail account you used to sign-up for ShopApp. I am not sure about any other email platform besides gmail, sorry I didn’t mention that sooner.

title: An excellent and natural user experience
content:
This app has positively wonderful UX / UI. Those responsible for it deserve to be commended and they should feel very proud. So, to the folks behind this: thank you. And please continue to design and build intuitive and delightful user experiences. I trust this app and I trust that its information is up-to-date and correct. Again: I trust this app! And you, reader, should too.

title: Poor Consumer Support
content:
I had ordered from this merchant, got charged for the first installment and for several days of waiting the product did not arrive. I tried to contact/ reach out to the merchant (Eyedra) and it seems they can’t be found all of a sudden. My next move was call my bank tied to the purchase and dispute the charge and I got approved (felt supported). Here comes Shop continually messaging me with my remaining balance from a non existing merchant and it’s time for me to reach out to Shop. Initial Customers Support was very poor and inefficient. Until I spoke to a “supervisor” which somehow were not able to help me with my concerns because for some reason, I could “not” validate my identity based on their records “as it shown”. At the same time, I was at my Shop App reading as it stated as to who I am as it appeared on my Shop Profile. I screenshot it as they automatically generated my full name and my last name and had a chance to update it real time while I was still talking to the representative (supervisor). He advised me to send the screenshots to their customer service.
What a way to spend my only night off to be dealing with one annoyance and then come up with another, to prove to them about my identity based of their records. Mind you, I have had several transactions with this app and had no problem coz these merchants delivers expect for this one merchant: Eyedra.
To think that I didn’t feel supported with Shop (Affirm) makes me wanna reconsider closing ties or stop doing any transactions with them in the future if this is how they treat clients. Two word for the day: “Lesson Learned.”

title: Some Legit Stores and Some Scams
content: I ordered a item off of a reputable store/website that i never purchased from before. When i placed my order it later told me i could track the details through shop app. I did. I received the order and everything worked out great. I later wanted to shop for a different item directly on the app itself. I seen different stores listing the item at the same price as one another. That was the first red flag 🚩 . I click on the links to take me directly to their websites and each of the 3 websites had the same items for sale for the same prices. That was the second red flag 🚩Then as i read their return policies and shipping policies, they detail how they aren’t responsible for costs and they give you info to contact them. I then searched the addresses they all gave, and they end up being residential homes in different states. The phone numbers they provide don’t work. That was the third red flag 🚩.  I then started to notice that in the search bar, reputable legit retailers have star reviews next to their names. And ones that don’t have reviews to their names obviously don’t because they are scam sellers. Shop app itself isn’t a scam but their are some sellers on there that are. So find out online about the store first. If they don’t have a physical store somewhere in the USA that you can walk into, then i wouldn’t attempt to purchase from them on the Shop app. Be patient and do research.

title: Great in theory, not in practice
content: This app is great for aggregating and tracking all your incoming shipments in one place. It uses your email to search for shipment notifications and statuses then updates in the app accordingly, though updates definitely lag and I wind up having to check the carriers site for updated information. My real issue is that it relies so heavily on the notifications in your email. Say I place an order from company XYZ. They send me an email notifying me that my package shipped and has the tracking info. That all shows up in the app. Great. But I also get an email from FedEx saying I have an incoming shipment and has the tracking info. That also shows up in the app but as a separate shipment. So now I have two items listed in the app for one shipment with the same tracking number. Not great but ok. Once the package gets delivered, FedEx sends me an email saying my package was delivered. That eventually shows up in the app as delivered. But company XYZ doesn’t send me an email. Unless I manually mark that second entry as delivered or delete entry entirely, that duplicate listing never changes its status from in transit to delivered despite having the same tracking number. So now you’re left with either having to sort through your orders on the app instead of your email then going to the carriers website to find the current status of your shipment because the app takes so long to update, entirely defeating the purpose of the app, or deal with a bunch of duplicates that you have to manually adjust with most shipments.

title: Not worth it
content:
Purchased an item online and the site wanted me to download this app, rather than just email me updates. Firstly it wanted access to ALL my mail so that it could scan it and hoover up all my personal information. In these days of data breaches and fraud, no thanks. Declined to give it access so it took me to the shipping info for just the seller in question and that told me no more than I could see on the sellers website! Overall offers me no value and expects all my personal data in return. App deleted.

UPDATE - I have read the Privacy Statement and of course it states that the operation of the app complies with all relevant laws. However, my issue is not that the app might be doing something illegal, rather it is harvesting personal information way above and beyond its stated purpose which was to track a delivery for me. According to the Apple App Store, Shop gathers, amongst other things, the following: Name, email address, physical address and phone number, even purchases all of which I accept may be necessary for tracking. In addition it can collect (and share with 3rd parties) data linked to you such as financial information, your precise location, user content such as emails and text messages. It further states that such information can be used for the purposes of marketing and delivering adverts.

Because I just wanted to know when my parcel would arrive, and not have data personally linked to me shared with 3rd parties and used for marketing, I removed the app from my device.

title: Is there anybody there?
content: I have used Shop on many occasions and had no problems until just recently.  I did not receive an item I paid for and I contacted the seller on more than one occasion to find out what was going on and asking for a refund as it was now long after the promise of ‘delivery within x days’.  I got no reply except for an automated one saying someone would get back to me soon.  No reply came despite more than one attempt.  Then I tried Shop as that is who I paid the money through.  This is when I discovered the app is only useful if you don’t have issues with the seller only to be informed that I ‘should contact the seller should any issues arise’.  I messaged Shop and told them I had tried that on more than one occasion but with only an automated response.  Shop never replied!  I wrote a review on Trustpilot yesterday and got an email allegedly from the seller.  It was all apologetic and asking me to contact if I needed any further help.  I replied immediately and got the automated response again and back to nothing since.  I am contacting my bank about the issue today and I will be avoiding buying anything that has an association with Shop app.  I’m very disappointed and annoyed that the seller seems to have responded via AI called Sydney and that Shop app still hasn’t replied  to any of my attempts to message them. Be careful people.  A paying app is no good if it takes your money but when you’re ignored by the seller you contact Shop and get ignored by them as well.  I’m very disappointed with Shop but will not use them again.

I can’t prove it but they haven’t had a penny more!!!!
